subject.title: fix(gateway): add per-request cancellation to prevent late node.invoke dispatch

question: Should this repair implement an explicit connection-bound per-request cancellation/deadline contract instead of approximating caller lifetime with a fixed server timer?
rationale: The server cannot infer configurable client or per-call timeout values from the current request frame, while the canonical security contract requires one authoritative lifetime and secure pending-to-effecting ordering.

options.title: Add authoritative cancellation
options.body: Negotiate and bind cancellation to the originating connection, propagate the actual deadline or abort, and reject cancellation once node dispatch begins.

options.title: Accept disconnect-only hardening
options.body: Land only socket-close protection with explicit security-owner acceptance while keeping the caller-timeout vulnerability open and tracked.

options.title: Pause for protocol design
options.body: Pause this PR until Gateway request state and cancellation ownership are designed as a broader additive protocol contract.

recommendation.title: Add authoritative cancellation
recommendation.body: Negotiate and bind cancellation to the originating connection, propagate the actual deadline or abort, and reject cancellation once node dispatch begins.
